integrity: Derivations of the invariant reduction and asymptotic laws are provided; no independent scientific verification or priority certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only even-width conformal-skew initial data and fixed positive inverse temperature, not almost-everywhere or general full-rank dynamics. Singular escape for general trajectories, generic normalized directions and generic completion-loss behavior remain unresolved. The complete proof is analytic; the finite checks are illustrative.
title: Polynomial escape with full-rank directional convergence in entropic diagonal completion
